citation.authors: Garg P, Mendiratta A, Banga A, Bucharles A et al
citation.journal: International Journal of Cardiology: Cardiovascular Risk and Prevention

record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of breathing exercises on blood pressure and heart rate
record.finding: Breathing exercises lowered systolic pressure by 7.06 mmHg (95% CI -10.20 to -3.92) and diastolic by 3.43 (-4.89 to -1.97), with a small fall in heart rate. The authors note the studies are not free of bias.
